prov.title: PROV-O: The PROV Ontology
prov.inspection_scope: Terms listed below only; no PROV conformance or import asserted.

sosa.title: Semantic Sensor Network Ontology
sosa.inspection_scope: Selected core classes only; observed properties and their specifications remain distinct.

dqv.title: Data on the Web Best Practices: Data Quality Vocabulary
dqv.inspection_scope: Dataset-quality vocabulary used by analogy only. This Note is work in progress, not a W3C Recommendation.

derivation.name: prov:Derivation
derivation.paraphrase: Entity-to-entity transformation, construction or updating represented as a qualified influence.

result.name: sosa:Result
result.paraphrase: A result of observation, actuation or sampling; simple values have a separate property.

metric.name: dqv:Metric
metric.paraphrase: A standard for measuring a quality dimension; a measurement provides its observed value.

observable.name: sosa:ObservableProperty
observable.paraphrase: An observable quality of a feature, rather than a specification describing that quality.

concepts.title: Evidence Reference
concepts.authored_definition: A qualified reference linking a claim or activity to an evidence item, with its intended evidential role and provenance.
concepts.rationale: Retain derivation as one related provenance pattern, not as a definition of evidential use. Evidence may be used without deriving a new entity or endorsing a claim; a citation does not establish independent corroboration.
concepts.context_interpretation: The reference keeps documentary identity and ordinary RX-021 linkage. Its local-edge difference is the added GE-001 specialization from EvidenceReferenceRole, not an altered direct association. RE-001/RE-002 and C-26 separately describe grounded use and distinct participants. R-68 is read with C-12 and its no-proof rationale, preserving support/challenge/context distinctions.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported source comparison, current ancestry/neighbor/set-policy and selected evidence/monitoring contracts; not a new engine, instance or independent expert evaluation.

concepts.title: Observation Result
concepts.authored_definition: An information result produced by an observation activity, qualified by subject, time, method and available units.
concepts.rationale: Retain SOSA Result as related output context. SOSA also covers actuation and sampling results, while this Riskium concept selects observation information qualified by subject, method, time and available units; no class equivalence or imported restriction is asserted.
concepts.context_interpretation: RX-022 relates an ObservationActivity to its informational result; RX-023 identifies the indicator and RX-024 the continuing RiskCase. RK2-026 can retain context and RK2-017 connects revisions. The result is neither its activity nor a risk occurrence; a numeric value alone is insufficient for cross-context comparison.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported source comparison, current ancestry/neighbor/set-policy and selected evidence/monitoring contracts; not a new engine, instance or independent expert evaluation.

concepts.title: Indicator
concepts.authored_definition: A versioned information specification of an observable or computed indicator, including its intended interpretation. A reported indicator value is an ObservationResult, not the specification.
concepts.rationale: Retain DQV Metric and SOSA ObservableProperty as bounded pattern comparisons. DQV concerns dataset quality; SOSA describes an observable feature quality. Riskium Indicator is an information specification, distinct from the property and its measured value.
concepts.context_interpretation: RX-023 links reported results to their indicator specification; RX-025 can anchor a threshold. Specification versions and interpretation remain documentary. Neither external property classes nor DQV domain constraints are automatically imported into Riskium.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported source comparison, current ancestry/neighbor/set-policy and selected evidence/monitoring contracts; not a new engine, instance or independent expert evaluation.

concepts.title: Threshold
concepts.authored_definition: A versioned information specification of a context-qualified decision boundary for an indicator or assessment scale, with a comparator, permissible value interpretation and applicability context.
concepts.rationale: Clarify the former scoped-absence label as a contrast in intended role: a DQV measuring standard does not itself specify a comparator-qualified decision boundary. No global absence, class disjointness or exact threshold equivalence is asserted.
concepts.context_interpretation: RX-025 and RK2-020 each permit an indicator or scale anchor. C-08 requires at least one supported anchor, with compatible interpretation if both exist; it does not require both. Qualitative boundaries retain scale semantics rather than invented numerical units. RX-027 records selected signal comparison.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported source comparison, current ancestry/neighbor/set-policy and selected evidence/monitoring contracts; not a new engine, instance or independent expert evaluation.

concepts.title: Signal
concepts.authored_definition: An information item indicating a potentially relevant change or condition and potentially prompting review; it does not by itself establish a risk event.
concepts.rationale: Retain the relationship to observation results without equating every signal with a SOSA Result or an actual risk event. A signal is information selected as potentially relevant to review; its significance requires context.
concepts.context_interpretation: RX-026 requires supporting observation results in the managed signal profile; RX-027 can identify thresholds and RX-028 can prompt case review. Revised RiskCase meaning was reviewed. Source incomplete material is retained without fabricating observations; neither an alert nor a crossed threshold automatically proves a risk occurrence or cause.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported source comparison, current ancestry/neighbor/set-policy and selected evidence/monitoring contracts; not a new engine, instance or independent expert evaluation.

boundaries.static_scope: Selected source relations, reference-role specialization, documentary identity and source statements only; not new evidence-use, threshold, SQL or ontology-engine execution.
boundaries.semantic_review: Independent semantic review remains #23; exact normative adoption remains #78.
boundaries.deployment_scope: All 82 documentary dispositions are inventoried; component qualification and publication/readback remain separate.

batch_findings: All five authored definitions, concept records and inherited edges are unchanged. Four complete local-edge sets are unchanged; EvidenceReference adds GE-001 from EvidenceReferenceRole while its direct associations remain unchanged. The added role retains its authored candidate status; no new scientific or independent approval is inferred.

Three RELATED and one ANALOGY labels are retained. Threshold changes its scoped-absence label to CONTRAST with DQV Metric, clarifying the different intended roles without claiming no relevant threshold vocabulary exists.

EvidenceReference remains documentary. An actual grounded evidential-use relationship is separately represented through EvidenceUseRelator, EvidenceItem and EvidenceReferenceRole. C-26 supplies distinctness/grounding requirements; multiplicity alone does not establish distinct individuals or claim truth.

Observation activity, informational result, indicator specification, threshold and signal remain distinct. C-08 requires an indicator or scale anchor, with compatible interpretation if both exist; qualitative boundaries do not need fabricated numerical units. A signal can prompt review without proving an occurrence or cause.

Every current catalog concept now has one disjoint documentary disposition across N2/N3a/N3b-1..6. The inventory includes three NEEDS_LICENSED_SOURCE decisions (criteria/appetite/tolerance) carried in batch-05. Recording them is not normative-source inspection; #78 and independent semantic review #23 remain open. Full curation-component selection, generator qualification and actual publication/readback remain N4/N5.
context_guard_note: Reference, role participation and evidence-use relationship remain distinct; a citation or provenance link is not proof of claim truth. Observation information and indicator specifications do not create actual risk events. Thresholds use supported indicator/scale semantics, and signals preserve context and uncertainty without inventing missing values.
source_access_note: All three primary HTML responses were directly retrieved and match the historical hashes. Four selected term passages retain edition/locator/fingerprint bindings. DQV is a Working Group Note used only for bounded comparison; SOSA and PROV constraints are not automatically imported. Full source documents are not redistributed.
